Context: 2. Salient Points

## 2. Salient Points  
- (a) Home Town.1. A Government servant may declare a home town which may be accepted by his Controlling Officer. The declaration made by the Government servant may be accepted and a detailed check may be applied only when he seeks a change. In exceptional circumstances, the Head of the Department may authorize a change in such declaration, only once during entire service. - GIDs, Rule 5.
